        {
            "@type": "FAQPage",
            "mainEntity": [
                {
                    "@type": "Question",
                    "name": "Can Mindbody replace my existing CRM, scheduling, and POS systems with one platform? ",
                    "acceptedAnswer": {
                        "@type": "Answer",
                        "text": "Yes, Mindbody can serve as a comprehensive platform that combines CRM, scheduling, and POS functionality in one system. The software includes client management features for tracking client information and relationships, robust scheduling capabilities for classes and appointments, and a complete point-of-sale system for processing transactions and managing retail products."
                    }
                },
                {
                    "@type": "Question",
                    "name": "Is Mindbody affordable for a small or new business?",
                    "acceptedAnswer": {
                        "@type": "Answer",
                        "text": "Yes. Nearly 6 in 10 businesses on Mindbody run from a single location. Mindbody has plans for businesses at every stage, so you only pay for the tools you need today. As you grow, you can add more, all the way up to multi-location and enterprise tools. You also get unlimited users per location, live customer support, and 1-on-1 setup and training to help you get started faster. Compare plans on our pricing page. "
                    }
                },
                {
                    "@type": "Question",
                    "name": "How can I manage my business from the Mindbody Business app?",
                    "acceptedAnswer": {
                        "@type": "Answer",
                        "text": "The Mindbody Business app enables you and your staff to manage operations on the go. You can: Add new clients, take photos, and capture signatures for liability waiversAccess client account and profile informationBrowse your staff scheduleSign clients in to classes and coursesBook, edit, and cancel appointments and check clients inAccept payment for appointments without being at the deskSell products, services, and contractsProcess purchases using the same payment methods available on your Mindbody business siteLogin is the same across the Business app and desktop experiences"
                    }
                },
                {
                    "@type": "Question",
                    "name": "Which third-party tools can I connect to Mindbody?",
                    "acceptedAnswer": {
                        "@type": "Answer",
                        "text": "Mindbody connects with a variety of third-party tools to help you run and grow your business. These include: Payroll tools such as ADP, Exact Payroll, and Paychex, which let you send payroll data directly from Mindbody.Door access systems that manage entry to your studio or gym, including turnstiles, doors, and lock hardware.Marketing and lead generation tools like Constant Contact, Mailchimp, Perkville, Meta Ads, and Google Ads, helping you run email campaigns, loyalty programs, and digital advertising.Additional services including Spivi (performance tracking and leaderboards), Bitlancer (late cancel and no-show fee processing),"
                    }
                },
                {
                    "@type": "Question",
                    "name": "How does Mindbody handle payments?",
                    "acceptedAnswer": {
                        "@type": "Answer",
                        "text": "Mindbody handles payments through integrated payment processors that work directly with your software. Mindbody Payments, powered by Stripe, is a modern processing platform that allows you to accept payments through the Mindbody app, online store, or at your business location with industry-leading fraud protection and transparency into your income."
                    }
                },
                {
                    "@type": "Question",
                    "name": "How can I automate payment issues and collections in Mindbody?",
                    "acceptedAnswer": {
                        "@type": "Answer",
                        "text": "Mindbody offers several tools to help you automate parts of your payments and collections process: You can automatically notify clients about failed or expiring payments through built-in auto emails, and use reports like Autopay Detail and Credit Card Expirations to quickly identify issues and follow up. Chargebacks can be tracked and managed and declined autopays can be converted into account balances that you can monitor and collect. While some actions—like responding to disputes or processing outstanding balances—still require manual steps, Mindbody streamlines most of the tracking and client communication so you can manage payment issues and collections more efficiently."
                    }
                },
                {
                    "@type": "Question",
                    "name": "How can I track leads and manage my sales pipeline in Mindbody?",
                    "acceptedAnswer": {
                        "@type": "Answer",
                        "text": "Mindbody\u0027s Lead Management includes: Sales pipeline dashboard: View and organize leads through sales stages, with drag-and-drop functionality and automated lead capture when new profiles are created.Follow-up tasks: Create and assign tasks to stay engaged with leads throughout the sales journey.Sales funnel analytics: Track performance metrics to understand what\u0027s working.\u2028Third-party integrations: Connect Google Ads lead forms to automatically flow leads into your pipeline.Third-party integrations: Connect Google Ads lead forms to automatically flow leads into your pipeline."
                    }
                },
                {
                    "@type": "Question",
                    "name": "What\u0027s the difference between having Manager and Owner permissions? ",
                    "acceptedAnswer": {
                        "@type": "Answer",
                        "text": "Both managers and owners share access to most daily operations like schedules, sales, and client management. The key difference is that Owner permission groups have full control over system-wide settings like user permissions, payment setup, and integrations. "
                    }
                },
                {
                    "@type": "Question",
                    "name": "Does Mindbody offer a way to manage staff schedules, substitutions, and permissions?",
                    "acceptedAnswer": {
                        "@type": "Answer",
                        "text": "Yes, you can manage staff schedules, automatic substitutions, and staff permissions all within your Mindbody software. Staff schedules: Manage class and event schedules, including assigning staff to classes and managing their appointment availability.Automatic substitutions: The Substitution Management feature allows staff to request substitutes via text message automation.Staff permissions: Control what staff members can access and do by setting permissions for scheduling substitutes, managing schedules, and viewing staff information."
                    }
                },
                {
                    "@type": "Question",
                    "name": "Can Mindbody help centralize staff management across multiple locations?",
                    "acceptedAnswer": {
                        "@type": "Answer",
                        "text": "Yes, Mindbody provides several features to help centralize staff management across locations: Multi-location staff management: Manage staff across all locations from one central site with a multi-location (datashare) setup.Staff permissions: Create customized permission groups that can be assigned to staff members across your network. With Ultimate pricing packages, you can individually customize and assign permissions by group.Staff login locations: Control which locations staff members can access and work from within your system.IP restrictions: Set up IP restrictions to ensure staff can only log in from specific locations, like your business locations, rather than personal devices."
                    }
                },
                {
                    "@type": "Question",
                    "name": "What types of reports and dashboards can I use to monitor my business?",
                    "acceptedAnswer": {
                        "@type": "Answer",
                        "text": "Mindbody offers a range of reports and dashboards to track performance across sales, clients, staff, and marketing. You can monitor revenue, attendance, payroll, retention, and lead conversion, plus view key metrics in real time through customizable dashboards and automated report delivery."
                    }
                },
                {
                    "@type": "Question",
                    "name": "How can I access centralized reports for multiple locations in Mindbody?",
                    "acceptedAnswer": {
                        "@type": "Answer",
                        "text": "Depending on your business needs, Mindbody offers comprehensive multi-location management through two main setup options. For smaller businesses, the datashare (multi-location) setup is ideal for locations that are close together and where clients frequently move between those locations. Mindbody software shows shared services, pricing, clients, and staff for multiple locations, while each location has its own dropdown menu for location-specific management. For Enterprise Solutions, you get network-wide control with a corporate dashboard that provides a complete view of all regions and locations. This includes corporate-level reporting with business intelligence dashboards, cross-location reports on sales, clients, and visits, and year-over-year revenue metrics. "
                    }
                },
                {
                    "@type": "Question",
                    "name": "Can I schedule and automate reports to be delivered regularly in Mindbody?",
                    "acceptedAnswer": {
                        "@type": "Answer",
                        "text": "Yes, you can schedule and automate reports in Mindbody. Reports are emailed automatically to specified recipients, with daily, weekly, or monthly delivery. "
                    }
                },
                {
                    "@type": "Question",
                    "name": "Can waivers or forms be required and signed digitally using Mindbody? ",
                    "acceptedAnswer": {
                        "@type": "Answer",
                        "text": "Yes, but there\u0027s some nuance. Forms and waivers are two separate tools, and here\u0027s how they work: Forms: Can be required (often per service) and can include a digital signature—including stylus signature in supported flows.Waivers: Can be required and are typically completed as a digital acknowledgment (like a checkbox) with a timestamp during booking, account creation, or at the front desk in the Business app. Note: signature behavior can vary by flow.With Mindbody, you can collect the right paperwork at the right moment, so check-in stays fast, your staff stays focused, and clients get to the good part sooner."
                    }
                }
            ]

					><dt class="faq__question heading heading--zeta">
Which third-party tools can I connect to Mindbody?
</dt><dd class="faq__answer"><p>Mindbody connects with a variety of third-party tools to help you run and grow your business.</p><p> </p><p>These include:</p><p> </p><ul><li data-list-item-id="ec6ef72670adc1275ce1b4efbe0126d73">Payroll tools such as ADP, Exact Payroll, and Paychex, which let you send payroll data directly from Mindbody.</li><li data-list-item-id="ed62b9eee9b94e1056a956d3900a591ee">Door access systems that manage entry to your studio or gym, including turnstiles, doors, and lock hardware.</li><li data-list-item-id="e6cfc42e693f92ff519725be79ecd32d8">Marketing and lead generation tools like Constant Contact, Mailchimp, Perkville, Meta Ads, and Google Ads, helping you run email campaigns, loyalty programs, and digital advertising.</li><li data-list-item-id="eb3a7ca23e847ce73f2cd991b8d7b07d7">Additional services including Spivi (performance tracking and leaderboards), Bitlancer (late cancel and no-show fee processing),</li></ul></dd></div><div class="faqList__item"
					><dt class="faq__question heading heading--zeta">
How does Mindbody handle payments?
</dt><dd class="faq__answer"><p>Mindbody handles payments through integrated payment processors that work directly with your software. Mindbody Payments, powered by Stripe, is a modern processing platform that allows you to accept payments through the Mindbody app, online store, or at your business location with industry-leading fraud protection and transparency into your income.</p></dd></div><div class="faqList__item"
					><dt class="faq__question heading heading--zeta">
How can I automate payment issues and collections in Mindbody?
</dt><dd class="faq__answer"><p>Mindbody offers several tools to help you automate parts of your payments and collections process:</p><p> </p><p>You can automatically notify clients about failed or expiring payments through built-in auto emails, and use reports like Autopay Detail and Credit Card Expirations to quickly identify issues and follow up.</p><p> </p><p>Chargebacks can be tracked and managed and declined autopays can be converted into account balances that you can monitor and collect.</p><p> </p><p>While some actions—like responding to disputes or processing outstanding balances—still require manual steps, Mindbody streamlines most of the tracking and client communication so you can manage payment issues and collections more efficiently.</p></dd></div><div class="faqList__item"
					><dt class="faq__question heading heading--zeta">
How can I track leads and manage my sales pipeline in Mindbody?
</dt><dd class="faq__answer"><p>Mindbody's Lead Management includes:<br> </p><ul><li data-list-item-id="eeaafb7a435de0a2c0ad3cb6c96ef2c35">Sales pipeline dashboard: View and organize leads through sales stages, with drag-and-drop functionality and automated lead capture when new profiles are created.</li><li data-list-item-id="e9af5e637d3554fa5231bf9908f3e9fde">Follow-up tasks: Create and assign tasks to stay engaged with leads throughout the sales journey.</li><li data-list-item-id="e9f31d64a705cd071a44086e189555fe0">Sales funnel analytics: Track performance metrics to understand what's working. Third-party integrations: Connect Google Ads lead forms to automatically flow leads into your pipeline.</li><li data-list-item-id="e6172e7254cbd5a1e1fe57d0f34430202">Third-party integrations: Connect Google Ads lead forms to automatically flow leads into your pipeline.</li></ul></dd></div><div class="faqList__item"
					><dt class="faq__question heading heading--zeta">
What's the difference between having Manager and Owner permissions? 
</dt><dd class="faq__answer"><p>Both managers and owners share access to most daily operations like schedules, sales, and client management. The key difference is that Owner permission groups have full control over system-wide settings like user permissions, payment setup, and integrations. </p></dd></div><div class="faqList__item"
					><dt class="faq__question heading heading--zeta">
Does Mindbody offer a way to manage staff schedules, substitutions, and permissions?
</dt><dd class="faq__answer"><p>Yes, you can manage staff schedules, automatic substitutions, and staff permissions all within your Mindbody software.</p><p> </p><ul><li data-list-item-id="eb073f62cf0d1ecdaa2783449c29d7111">Staff schedules: Manage class and event schedules, including assigning staff to classes and managing their appointment availability.</li><li data-list-item-id="eac337020b35472514843e0a7c8f13695">Automatic substitutions: The Substitution Management feature allows staff to request substitutes via text message automation.</li><li data-list-item-id="e2f66fb76ae1a54f76b43b455d221cf72">Staff permissions: Control what staff members can access and do by setting permissions for scheduling substitutes, managing schedules, and viewing staff information.</li></ul></dd></div><div class="faqList__item"
					><dt class="faq__question heading heading--zeta">
Can Mindbody help centralize staff management across multiple locations?
</dt><dd class="faq__answer"><p>Yes, Mindbody provides several features to help centralize staff management across locations:</p><p> </p><ul><li data-list-item-id="e544dc2e14d793df6ec652737b32e970e">Multi-location staff management: Manage staff across all locations from one central site with a multi-location (datashare) setup.</li><li data-list-item-id="ec1603ab5b1c68def7ca740e31fe3ecb5">Staff permissions: Create customized permission groups that can be assigned to staff members across your network. With Ultimate pricing packages, you can individually customize and assign permissions by group.</li><li data-list-item-id="e62c07e220db3524506cc0ec37e00474a">Staff login locations: Control which locations staff members can access and work from within your system.</li><li data-list-item-id="eaeb8b5c3b46b86c9bbc31d92d1e1549e">IP restrictions: Set up IP restrictions to ensure staff can only log in from specific locations, like your business locations, rather than personal devices.</li></ul></dd></div><div class="faqList__item"
					><dt class="faq__question heading heading--zeta">
What types of reports and dashboards can I use to monitor my business?
</dt><dd class="faq__answer"><p>Mindbody offers a range of reports and dashboards to track performance across sales, clients, staff, and marketing. You can monitor revenue, attendance, payroll, retention, and lead conversion, plus view key metrics in real time through customizable dashboards and automated report delivery.</p></dd></div><div class="faqList__item"
					><dt class="faq__question heading heading--zeta">
How can I access centralized reports for multiple locations in Mindbody?
</dt><dd class="faq__answer"><p>Depending on your business needs, Mindbody offers comprehensive multi-location management through two main setup options. <br><br>For smaller businesses, the datashare (multi-location) setup is ideal for locations that are close together and where clients frequently move between those locations. Mindbody software shows shared services, pricing, clients, and staff for multiple locations, while each location has its own dropdown menu for location-specific management. <br><br>For Enterprise Solutions, you get network-wide control with a corporate dashboard that provides a complete view of all regions and locations. This includes corporate-level reporting with business intelligence dashboards, cross-location reports on sales, clients, and visits, and year-over-year revenue metrics. </p></dd></div><div class="faqList__item"
					><dt class="faq__question heading heading--zeta">
Can I schedule and automate reports to be delivered regularly in Mindbody?
</dt><dd class="faq__answer"><p>Yes, you can schedule and automate reports in Mindbody. Reports are emailed automatically to specified recipients, with daily, weekly, or monthly delivery. </p></dd></div><div class="faqList__item"
					><dt class="faq__question heading heading--zeta">
Can waivers or forms be required and signed digitally using Mindbody? 
</dt><dd class="faq__answer"><p>Yes, but there's some nuance. Forms and waivers are two separate tools, and here's how they work:<br> </p><ul><li data-list-item-id="eda8ac0991afdc02307dec6de60a14815">Forms: Can be required (often per service) and can include a digital signature—including stylus signature in supported flows.</li><li data-list-item-id="ea779142d9d42c449d0e0cc02390bbb78">Waivers: Can be required and are typically completed as a digital acknowledgment (like a checkbox) with a timestamp during booking, account creation, or at the front desk in the Business app. Note: signature behavior can vary by flow.</li></ul><p>With Mindbody, you can collect the right paperwork at the right moment, so check-in stays fast, your staff stays focused, and clients get to the good part sooner.</p></dd></div></dl></div></div></section><section  class="customPage__bodySection paragraph_one_liner"><div class="oneLiner paragraph theme--white oneLiner--separatorLineTop oneLiner--separatorLineBottom"><div class="oneLiner__container ctnr-main"><div class="oneLiner__wrapper"><p>Not all features are available in all regions or on all tiers. Quoted statistics are not guaranteed.<br>Results vary.</p><p><br><sup>1</sup>No guarantees.
